Life at Zorro

Working at Zorro means building something that matters—together. We're on a mission to make healthcare fairer, simpler, and more accessible for everyone. That takes a team as diverse and forward-thinking as the solutions we're creating. We believe that the best ideas come from different perspectives, a shared purpose, and a willingness to challenge the status quo. Whether you're a product expert, engineer, customer success manager—or something we don't even know we're looking for yet—Zorro is a place to grow, make your mark, and impact how health benefits work for real people.

Driven by core beliefs

Challenge the status quo

We don't accept "that's how it's always been"—we innovate to create better solutions. We innovate to drive better solutions.

Deliver measurable impact

Our work directly influences people's health and financial wellbeing.

Commit to excellence

We strive for the highest quality in everything we do, turning challenges into opportunities.

Embrace technology

We leverage cutting-edge tech to enhance the lives of our users.

Collaborate fully

We operate as one team, ready to roll up our sleeves and support each other.

Just a few of our perks & benefits

Comprehensive health coverage

Perhaps unsurprisingly, you'll have access to top-tier health plan tailored to your needs.

Equity options

Be an owner in the company you're helping to build.

Remote-friendly culture

We're fully aware that we love our work family, but we also have our own.

Generous time off

Enjoy ample vacation days and company-wide holidays to recharge.

Professional growth

You'll find countless opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.

Purpose-driven work

Help shape the future of healthcare — and make a real difference in people's lives.
